observations.footwork: Foreground person holds a stationary stance. Background person is moving laterally from center to the far right side of the frame.
observations.guard: Foreground person has both hands up in a guard position, holding green pad-like objects. Background person's arms are down.
observations.upper_body: Foreground person is in an orthodox boxing stance with a slight forward lean. Background person is upright and running.
observations.distance: Background person is moving away from the foreground person, increasing distance.
observations.notable: Background person appears to be performing a conditioning or footwork drill, moving quickly around the perimeter. Foreground person is anchored.

observations.footwork: Foreground person has stopped actively moving. Background person continues moving laterally, now from the right side back toward the center.
observations.guard: Foreground person's hands are dropped to waist level. Guard is down.
observations.upper_body: Foreground person is more upright and relaxed. Background person is moving fluidly back and forth.
observations.distance: Background person is moving closer to the foreground person again.
observations.notable: A rest or instruction pause appears to occur in this segment as the foreground person drops their guard.

observations.footwork: Foreground person resumes a grounded stance. Background person has moved to the far left side of the frame and remains there.
observations.guard: Foreground person's hands are back up in a guard position.
observations.upper_body: Foreground person is back in an athletic, defensive posture. Background person is upright on the left side.
observations.distance: Background person is on the far left, maintaining a wide distance from the foreground person.
observations.notable: The foreground person has returned to a ready stance, suggesting the drill or rest period is over.

movement_events.detail: Background person moves rapidly from the center to the far right side, increasing separation from the foreground person.
Foreground person lowers their hands from guard to waist level, indicating a brief rest or instruction period.
Background person changes direction and runs from the right side back toward the center, decreasing the distance.
Foreground person raises their hands back into a guard position, resuming the drill.
Background person continues moving and settles on the far left side of the frame.
